Based on the error reports in Verilator (the re-definition of `resp_t` in each module, plus the multiple inside-generate struct definitions in `axi_dw_upsizer.sv`), you will need to touch:

  • The central package where `resp_t` is first declared: src/axi_pkg.sv  
  • The upsizer itself, which is where the in-generate struct is illegally re-defined: src/axi_dw_upsizer.sv  
  • Its mirror downsizer, which has the same pattern of student-generated structs and its own `resp_t` parameter: src/axi_dw_downsizer.sv  
  • And finally any other DW-style converter that declares `resp_t` in its own parameter list – e.g. the ID-width converter: src/axi_id_width_converter.sv  

Fixing these four will resolve both the original per-module `parameter type resp_t = logic;` collisions and the duplicate typedefs in the generate loops.  

```  
src/axi_pkg.sv  
src/axi_dw_upsizer.sv  
src/axi_dw_downsizer.sv  
src/axi_id_width_converter.sv  
```
